brief: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000.

requirements.evidence: The build already has one full base (piece:0,0,0;full). I left it unchanged because the drawer it was meant to hold couldn't be fitted.
There's no part by that name: searching the catalog for "turbo" found nothing, and no drawer sockets are offered on the current build. I didn't substitute a different drawer without your say-so.

finish.summary: I didn't build this because there's no part called "hex-turbo-drawer-9000". Searching the catalog for "turbo" found nothing. The drawer frames that do exist are notch frames (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf/-fm, also in double-height -x2 versions) and bay frames (hex-drawer-frame-bay-n/-s, also in -x2 versions). There are also cut-face drawers in classic, slide, swing, long and longbin styles, which fit on a half base. Right now the build is a single full base at 0,0,0, and nothing on it takes a drawer: no drawer sockets are offered. I left it as it was rather than swap in a different part. If you'd like a real drawer, tell me which one. I can change the base to a half base for a cut-face drawer, or add a second base beside it for a notch drawer.

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
